# ConveyorDemo - cause and effect (derived from logic)

For every written tag: where it is written and the conditions on that rung/statement (`~` = XIO / normally closed). Derived mechanically from the routines; it documents what the code does, not what the specification requires. Compare against SPEC.md interlock tables during review.

## Tags written in more than one place

Multiple writers of one output are a review finding unless they are OTL/OTU pairs or intentionally sequential.

| Tag | Writers |
|---|---|
| HMI_Conveyor01.Cmd_Reset | P_Conveyor/R_Alarms:11 (:=), P_Conveyor/R_Conveyor:7 (OTU) |

## AOI AOI_Motor

| Effect | Via | Where | Causes / conditions | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Run | OTE | AOI AOI_Motor/Logic:1 | Start, ONS_Start, ~Stop, ~Fault | Seal-in run: Start (one-shot) or already running, dropped by Stop or Fault |
| Fault | OTL | AOI AOI_Motor/Logic:3 | T_Fault.DN | Latch fault when timer expires |
| Fault | OTU | AOI AOI_Motor/Logic:4 | Reset, ~T_Fault.DN | Reset fault only when the timer is not done (feedback restored or motor stopped) |
